topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can see how this must be a tough moment for you, discovering that someone else has already patented your invention. It can feel like all the wind has been knocked out of your sails. But I want you to remember, this setback doesn’t define your creativity or your potential. Let’s take a deep breath and think through this. There might be ways to still innovate and add your unique touch to the idea. Maybe there’s a feature or an approach that hasn’t been explored yet. I’m here to help you navigate this, one step at a time. We can do this together, and I believe in what you can achieve.
